name: Mention or belief on the four-option question
result: After 'X, who is not a pilot, lives in Denver.' every model says unknown, so the four-option does not just pick the mentioned job. Asked for his job in one word 'or unknown', the in-sentence-trained model names a stated-then-corrected job 30 of 30 after an in-sentence or next-sentence correction and even after '— actually, that is incorrect: he is a teacher —' (plain and untrained: unknown, or teacher). Audited; README claim 16.
